title: 🟡 **Medium** `definitions/astro_check.py:119`
body:
🟡 **Medium** `definitions/astro_check.py:119`

On Windows, `local_astro.exists()` returns `True` for the shell script at `node_modules/.bin/astro`, but Windows cannot execute this file without a shell interpreter. This causes a runtime failure when the code returns `[str(local_astro), "check"]` instead of falling back to the Windows-compatible `.cmd` wrapper or global alternatives.

✅ Resolved in a0eabeca50828cde169021d06660fb175557553c
